lead: A `.nvst` case configures its run through `--FILE nvs.toml--`, and a scratch probe at the repo root does not.
body: `crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs` runs every case in a temp directory with each `--FILE <path>--` section written into it. The repo's `nvs.toml` sets `origin = "https://example.test"`, so `nvs run scratch.nvs` from the root answers `Core\Router::urlAbsolute` and proves nothing. Probe from a scratch directory carrying the case's `nvs.toml`.
